name: Thornling
flavor: A shrub with a grudge and very pointy elbows.

name: Bog Hopper
flavor: A toad the size of a footstool. It thinks you are a fly.

name: Moss Wisp
flavor: A glowing puff of moss. Pretty, until it pecks.

name: Barkback Boar
flavor: Its back is half bark, half rock, and all bad mood.

name: Spore Puffer
flavor: A mushroom that sneezes on purpose.

name: Elder Thornling
flavor: Older, bigger, and still holding the same grudge.

name: Bramble Troll
flavor: Guardian of Mossy Hollow. Mostly guards a nap spot.

name: Pincher Crab
flavor: Walks sideways, holds grudges forwards.

name: Gull Bandit
flavor: Has stolen 400 sandwiches and counting.

name: Brine Slime
flavor: Salty in every sense.

name: Kelp Lurker
flavor: Looks like seaweed. Is seaweed. Is angry seaweed.

name: Shell Knight
flavor: A hermit crab in borrowed armor. Very polite. Very stabby.

name: Big Pincher
flavor: The Pincher Crab everyone else is scared of.

name: Crab King
flavor: Ruler of Saltmarsh Shore. The crown is a bottle cap.

name: Ember Imp
flavor: Laughs at its own jokes. They are not good.

name: Ash Lizard
flavor: Basks on lava rocks. Regrets nothing.

name: Cinder Beetle
flavor: A beetle with a coal for a back.

name: Smog Bat
flavor: Coughs constantly. Mostly on you.

name: Lava Toad
flavor: The Bog Hopper's spicy cousin.

name: Imp Chieftain
flavor: Wears a crown made of other imps' hats.

name: Magma Wyrm
flavor: It lives in the volcano. It IS mostly volcano.

name: Spark Sprite
flavor: A tiny ball of static with a big attitude.

name: Thunder Goat
flavor: Climbs cliffs, eats tin cans, fears nothing.

name: Cliff Harpy
flavor: Sings beautifully. Only knows one song. It is a scream.

name: Gale Hawk
flavor: Faster than you. Smugger than you.

name: Granite Ram
flavor: Its horns are literal rocks. It is very proud of them.

name: Thunderhead
flavor: A grumpy cloud that wants your lunch money.

name: Storm Roc
flavor: A bird so big it has its own weather.

name: Frostbite Hare
flavor: Fluffy, fast, and bites ankles on purpose.

name: Ice Wraith
flavor: A cold draft that learned to hold a grudge.

name: Glacier Turtle
flavor: It has been walking to the same rock for nine years.

name: Yeti Cub
flavor: Small, for a yeti. Large, for everything else.

name: Rime Wolf
flavor: Hunts in packs. This one got lost.

name: Rime Alpha
flavor: The one the pack was looking for.

name: Glacier Hydra
flavor: Three heads, three opinions, one very cold breath.

name: Tunnel Mole
flavor: Cannot see you. Can definitely smell you.

name: Crystal Crawler
flavor: A spider made of gemstones. Priceless. Furious.

name: Lantern Gnome
flavor: Mines for gold. Finds you instead. Disappointed.

name: Gemback Lizard
flavor: Its back is worth a fortune. It knows.

name: Rust Sprite
flavor: A spark that lives in old mine carts.

name: Foreman Golem
flavor: Wears a hard hat. Takes safety very seriously.

name: Iron Golem
flavor: Built to guard the deepest mine. Still guarding. Very sturdy.

name: Dawn Sprite
flavor: Wakes up early and wants everyone to know.

name: Dusk Bat
flavor: Only comes out at twilight. Which is always, up here.

name: Sun Knight
flavor: Polishes its armor between every swing.

name: Shade Stalker
flavor: You can only see it out of the corner of your eye.

name: Twilight Moth
flavor: Half dawn, half dusk, all dust.

name: Eclipse Herald
flavor: Announces the Eclipse Dragon. Loudly. Constantly.

name: Eclipse Dragon
flavor: The oldest dragon in the world. Half sun, half moon, and not in the mood.

name: Murk Toad
flavor: Sits in the mud all day. Is, technically, also mud.

name: Will-o'-Whisper
flavor: A floating lantern that whispers your name. Usually wrong.

name: Reed Stalker
flavor: A long-legged bird that pretends to be a reed. Badly.

name: Bogling
flavor: A small mud goblin who thinks it is very scary.

name: Lily Snapper
flavor: A turtle wearing a lily pad. It is very proud of the lily pad.

name: Old Croaker
flavor: The oldest toad in the Fen. Her croak shakes the reeds.

name: Whisperwillow
flavor: An ancient willow whose branches whisper. Mostly complaints.

name: Cog Crawler
flavor: A clockwork beetle. Ticks when it is thinking. Ticks a lot.

name: Brass Sentry
flavor: Still guarding the gate. The gate fell down 300 years ago.

name: Boiler Bot
flavor: A round little boiler on legs. Whistles when angry. Always whistling.

name: Spark Hound
flavor: A clockwork dog with a coal for a heart. Very good boy. Very hot boy.

name: Gargoyle Pup
flavor: A stone gargoyle that only just woke up. It is grumpy about it.

name: Captain Clank
flavor: The fortress captain, a dented automaton who still salutes everyone.

name: Cinderforge Colossus
flavor: The ruins' last guardian, a stone giant with a furnace for a heart.

name: Hoot Shade
flavor: An owl made of night. Asks "who?" and never likes the answer.

name: Frostcap Shroom
flavor: A glowing ice mushroom. Bonks things. Mostly shins.

name: Snickerbark
flavor: A walking stump that giggles at its own spooky stories.

name: Shadow Fox
flavor: A fox of shadow with a moon-silver tail. Steals socks. Nobody knows why.

name: Rimeback Badger
flavor: A badger with frosty fur and a permanently bad mood.

name: Duskhorn
flavor: The great stag of the night woods. Its antlers hold the stars.

name: Moonwell Wyrm
flavor: A serpent made of night sky that lives in the moonwell and steals dreams.

name: Sand Scarab
flavor: A beetle with a golden shell. Rolls things. Mostly you.

name: Mirage Jackal
flavor: Is it there? Is it not? It is there, and it is biting.

name: Glimmer Lizard
flavor: A lizard that sunbathes so hard it started to glow.

name: Dune Sentinel
flavor: A sandstone statue that guards a door. The door is long gone.

name: Treasure Mimic
flavor: Looks like treasure. Has teeth. Was not treasure.

name: Riddle Sphinx
flavor: Asks a riddle. Never waits for the answer. Pounces.

name: Aurum Basilisk
flavor: A golden basilisk. Its gaze turns things to gold, including, it hopes, you.
